decisions.summary: Personal KG search public contract remains additive and backward compatible
decisions.reason: The public route remains GET /api/learning/memory-candidates/search and still returns { candidates: [...] }. Existing exact phrase behavior remains valid; the additive fallback only accepts rows where all normalized query tokens appear in body when phrase shape differs. Owner, visibility, redaction, rejected-status, cognitive_type, and limit filters remain in the same read path. Contract evidence is docs/architecture/personal-kg-tokenized-search-architecture.md, docs/specs/story-personal-kg-tokenized-search-spec.md C-001 through C-005, and tests/e2e/story-personal-kg-tokenized-search-contract.spec.ts ac:1 through ac:6.
